names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 2 noiembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Mărturisitor Gavriil Georgianul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Γαβριήλ ο Ομολογητής - Σαλός», with the rank words left off. The page's own transliteration of the surname is «Ουργκεμπάτζε».

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Cuviosul Gavril Urgebadze s-a născut în capitala Georgiei, Tbilisi, pe 26 august 1929.»

death.note: doxologia.ro: «s-a retras la Mănăstirea Samtavro de lângă Mtshketa, unde a adormit în ziua de 2 noiembrie 1995».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

source.text: doxologia.ro, 2 noiembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Mărturisitor Gavriil Georgianul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Γαβριήλ ο Ομολογητής - Σαλός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: «Οσιος Γαβριηλ ο Ομολογητης - Σαλος (1929 - 1995)», the archimandrite Gabriel Urgebadze. The folder's existing dates are left untouched: the heading gives the same years. The whole of the page's prose is the canonisation: «Στις 20 Δεκεμβρίου του 2012 μ.Χ., σύμφωνα με την απόφαση της Συνόδου της Αποστολικής Αυτοκέφαλης Ορθόδοξης Εκκλησίας της Γεωργίας ανακηρύχθηκε Άγιος ο αρχιμανδρίτης Γαβριήλ (Ουργκεμπάτζε) με το εξής όνομα: Όσιος Πατήρ Γαβριήλ, ο Ομολογητής – Σάλος. Η μνήμη του θα τιμάται στις 2 Νοεμβρίου.» No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Glasul Apostolului Pavel ce zice: „Noi suntem nebuni pentru Hristos” auzindu-l robul Tău, Sfântul Gavriil, nebun s-a făcut pentru tine pe pământ. Pentru aceasta, săvârșind pomenirea lui, Ție ne rugăm, Doamne mântuiește sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Gavriil Georgianul, Glasul 1

english.text: Hearing the voice of the Apostle Paul that says, “We are fools for Christ,” your servant Saint Gabriel became a fool for you upon earth. Therefore, as we keep his memory, we pray to you: Lord, save our souls.
